note: Single-polarity row. TestSFlowV5FlowSampleSentWithinOneSecond hands a sample to the real sflow FlowEncoder with a real Sender and requires the datagram on the collector socket within one second of the call, so an encoder holding a sample longer than 1 s goes red while one flushing sooner passes, matching the quote; TestExportFlowSampleDispatch proves exportFlowSample dispatches synchronously. Counter samples are sent synchronously in the poll (x-26 units).
